sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空中的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的背后是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 上千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能几乎每年都是联盟里最好的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用一个不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢一个平底锅就能做好的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝创立175周年，帮助您理解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅即可享受特别优惠，网址为nytimes.com斜杠subscribe。

sentences.en: Hey, it's Michael.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是迈克尔。

sentences.en: Today we have something really special for you.
sentences.zh: 今天我们为你准备了一些非常特别的内容。

sentences.en: A blissful break from the news.
sentences.zh: 一段远离新闻的惬意休憩。

sentences.en: It's a new series from NYT Audio called Animal.
sentences.zh: 这是《纽约时报》音频部推出的一档名为《动物》的新系列节目。

sentences.en: My colleague Sam Anderson from The Times Magazine traveled the world to have encounters with animals.
sentences.zh: 我的同事、来自《泰晤士报杂志》的萨姆·安德森环游世界去与动物相遇。

sentences.en: Not to claim them or to tame them, but just to appreciate them.
sentences.zh: 不是为了占有它们或驯服它们，而只是为了欣赏它们。

sentences.en: Each episode is a journey to get closer to a creature that Sam loves.
sentences.zh: 每一集都是一次走近萨姆深爱的某种生物的旅程。

sentences.en: For the next six weeks, we'll be running this limited series every Sunday here on the Daily Feed.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的六周里，我们将在每周日的“每日之声”栏目中播出这个有限系列。

sentences.en: But if you want to hear all the episodes right now, you can search for it wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 但如果你想现在就听完所有单集，可以在你获取播客的任何地方搜索它。

sentences.en: Today, episode five.
sentences.zh: 今天播出第五集。

sentences.en: Take a listen.
sentences.zh: 听听看吧。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, this is Animal.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，这里是《动物》。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Anderson.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·安德森。

sentences.en: Episode five, Wolves.
sentences.zh: 第五集，狼。

sentences.en: Well, we should, um...
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们应该，呃……

sentences.en: The shop closes at six.
sentences.zh: 店六点关门。

sentences.en: Do you think we'll be back by then?
sentences.zh: 你觉得我们那时候能赶回来吗？
可以，5点15分。

sentences.en: Uh, maybe.
sentences.zh: 呃，也许吧。

sentences.en: I can't imagine that there'll be, like, a ton to do that.
sentences.zh: 我想象不出那边会有多少事情要做。

sentences.en: No, I agree.
sentences.zh: 对，我同意。

sentences.en: I don't think we need to do that much.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们不需要做那么多事。

sentences.en: I mean, we just want to make the pilgrimage to the...
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们只是想去朝圣……

sentences.en: Oh, really?
sentences.zh: 哦，真的吗？

sentences.en: ...the statue, yeah.
sentences.zh: ……那个雕像，对。

sentences.en: Okay, okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧，好吧。

sentences.en: Do you know about the statue?
sentences.zh: 你知道那座雕像的事吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不知道。

sentences.en: Okay, we're going to tell you in the car.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们在车上告诉你。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And you can tell the driver.
sentences.zh: 你可以告诉司机。

sentences.en: Yes, okay.
sentences.zh: 好的，行。

sentences.en: The first thing I remember about our trip to the Wolves statue is that we almost didn't go.
sentences.zh: 关于我们去狼雕像的那趟旅行，我记起的第一件事就是我们差点没去成。

sentences.en: People told us not to bother.
sentences.zh: 人们告诉我们不用白费力气了。

sentences.en: The memorial is out in the middle of absolute nowhere on the edge of this tiny village in Japan.
sentences.zh: 那个纪念碑在完全荒凉的穷乡僻壤，位于日本一个极小村庄的边缘。

sentences.en: It would take all day to get there and probably be a giant anti-climax.
sentences.zh: 去那里要花一整天，而且很可能会是一场巨大的反高潮。

sentences.en: But I was already in Japan because I was working on a story for the magazine about Hayao Miyazaki, the animator.
sentences.zh: 但我当时已经在日本了，因为我正在为杂志做一个关于动画师宫崎骏的故事。

sentences.en: And since I'd come this far, I just felt like I really needed to do this.
sentences.zh: 既然我已经来了这么远，我只是觉得我真的必须去一趟。

sentences.en: Oh, God, it's really pouring.
sentences.zh: 天哪，雨下得真大。

sentences.en: Bullet train from Tokyo to Kyoto.
sentences.zh: 从东京到京都的新干线。

sentences.en: Regular train from Kyoto to a smaller city called Nara, which is famous for its deer.
sentences.zh: 从京都换乘普通列车去一个叫奈良的小城市，那里以鹿闻名。

sentences.en: We come out of the train station and it's pouring rain.
sentences.zh: 我们一出火车站，雨就倾盆而下。

sentences.en: That's another reason not to go on the pilgrimage because it's just soaking rain constantly all day long.
sentences.zh: 这也是不去朝圣的另一个原因，因为整整一天雨都在不停地下，把人浇透。

sentences.en: I'm with Crystal Duhaime, who's carrying a gigantic microphone around everywhere, and then Samson Yee, our incredible interpreter.
sentences.zh: 和我在一起的有走到哪里都带着一个巨大麦克风的克rystal·迪海姆，还有我们的王牌口译员萨姆森·伊。

sentences.en: And so we step out of the train station into the rain and there's this black car waiting for us.
sentences.zh: 于是我们走出火车站进入雨中，一辆黑色的轿车正在那里等我们。

sentences.en: And out steps our driver, who's this 30-something man, nicely dressed.
sentences.zh: 走出来的是我们的司机，一个三十多岁、衣着体面的男人。

sentences.en: He's wearing like a gray suit with a red tie.
sentences.zh: 他穿着一件灰色西装，系着红领带。

sentences.en: Samson talks to him and says, his name is Daisuke.
sentences.zh: 萨姆森跟他交谈后说，他叫大辅。

sentences.en: Daisuke-san, to be polite.
sentences.zh: 尊称他为大辅先生。

sentences.en: And Samson climbed into the front of the taxi to sit next to Daisuke so that he can interpret our conversation.
sentences.zh: 萨姆森爬进出租车前座坐在大辅旁边，这样他就能帮我们翻译对话了。

sentences.en: We start heading out of the city on this kind of wild, windy back road, and immediately we're sort of in the middle of nowhere and it's still pouring.
sentences.zh: 我们开始沿着一条狂野、曲折的乡间小路驶出城市，立刻就仿佛置身于荒郊野岭，而且雨还在下。

sentences.en: It's foggy.
sentences.zh: 雾蒙蒙的。

sentences.en: We're passing through woods and bamboo and it is really beautiful.
sentences.zh: 我们穿过树林和竹林，景色真的非常美。

sentences.en: It feels like we're driving into an old landscape painting.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像是开进了一幅古老的风景画里。

sentences.en: So, Samson, let me tell you about the statue since you have no idea what we're doing.
sentences.zh: 那么，萨姆森，让我给你讲讲这座雕像的事吧，既然你完全不知道我们在干什么。

sentences.en: Yeah, I remember asking.
sentences.zh: 对，我记得我问过。

sentences.en: Well, maybe ask Daisuke-san if he knows anything about the Japanese wolf.
sentences.zh: 好吧，也许可以问问大辅先生他是否知道任何关于日本狼的事情。

sentences.en: Can you ask Daisuke-san, our driver, if he knows anything about the Japanese wolf?
sentences.zh: 你能问问我们的司机大辅先生，他知道日本狼的事吗？

sentences.en: So, Samson did and no, he'd never heard about it.
sentences.zh: 于是萨姆森问了，结果没有，他从未听说过。

sentences.en: But...
sentences.zh: 但是……

sentences.en: I don't know anything about the wolf, but I love animals and I have a chihuahua at home.
sentences.zh: 我对狼一无所知，但我喜欢动物，我家里养了一只吉娃娃。

sentences.en: I have a chihuahua.
sentences.zh: 我有一只吉娃娃。

sentences.en: What's the name of the chihuahua?
sentences.zh: 那只吉娃娃叫什么名字？

sentences.en: Chihuahua, what's the name of the chihuahua?
sentences.zh: 吉娃娃，那只吉娃娃叫什么名字？

sentences.en: Goutaro.
sentences.zh: 五郎。

sentences.en: Goutaro.
sentences.zh: 五郎。

sentences.en: Goutaro.
sentences.zh: 五郎。

sentences.en: Boy's name.
sentences.zh: 男孩子的名字。

sentences.en: He has a boy's name, but it's a girl.
sentences.zh: 他起了一个男孩子的名字，但它是个母的。

sentences.en: Poor Goutaro.
sentences.zh: 可怜的五郎。

sentences.en: And Samson laughed because Goutaro is a very male Japanese name.
sentences.zh: 萨姆森笑了，因为五郎是一个非常男性的日本名字。

sentences.en: It's like apparently like some kind of warrior name.
sentences.zh: 显然就像是什么武士的名字一样。

sentences.en: He said the Chinese character for it means like hard metal.
sentences.zh: 他说这个名字的汉字意思是硬金属。

sentences.en: And Daisuke named this chihuahua the most masculine, tough name he could think of
sentences.zh: 大辅给这只吉娃娃起了他能想到的最具男子气概、最硬核的名字

sentences.en: because chihuahuas are so fierce and have such strong personalities.
sentences.zh: 因为吉娃娃非常凶猛，个性极强。

sentences.en: So he did that deliberately.
sentences.zh: 所以他是故意这么做的。

sentences.en: And the fact that he would connect that to wolves, that was the funny thing about him.
sentences.zh: 他会把这与狼联系起来，这正是他有趣的地方。

sentences.en: It's like instantly we said wolves and he was like, oh, I love animals and I have a dog.
sentences.zh: 就像我们一说狼，他就马上说，哦，我喜欢动物，我有一只狗。

sentences.en: A chihuahua, which is on one hand, a hilarious answer.
sentences.zh: 一只吉娃娃，这方面听起来令人捧腹。

sentences.en: But on the other hand, makes perfect sense because wolves and dogs, I came to learn on this trip, are essentially the same thing.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面又完全说得通，因为我在这次旅行中了解到，狼和狗本质上是同一回事。

sentences.en: I mean, we went to talk to one of the great dog scientists on planet Earth and he was telling me that dogs are really just wolves that have developed over thousands of years
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们去采访了地球上最伟大的犬类科学家之一，他告诉我狗其实就是经过几千年演变而成的狼

sentences.en: a very intimate relationship with human beings.
sentences.zh: 与人类建立了非常亲密的关。系

sentences.en: He's done all this incredible research, including discovering that dogs cry when their owners come home.
sentences.zh: 他做了所有这些不可思议的研究，包括发现狗在主人回家时会流泪。

sentences.en: After a long period away, they have moisture in their eyes
sentences.zh: 在经历了长时间的分离后，它们的眼睛里会有水分

sentences.en: and wolves don't.
sentences.zh: 而狼则没有。

sentences.en: So that's one of the ways they're different.
sentences.zh: 所以这是它们不同的地方之一。

sentences.en: But otherwise, they're just, it's more a continuum than it is a bright line that divides them.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，它们只是，这更多是一个连续体，而不是一条划分它们的清晰界线。

sentences.en: So Daisuke got that right away.
sentences.zh: 所以大辅立刻就明白了这一点。

sentences.en: He was like, you're asking me about wolves?
sentences.zh: 他当时想，你们在问我关于狼的事吗？

sentences.en: I'm going to talk about my dog.
sentences.zh: 我要讲讲我的狗。

sentences.en: I was explaining what we've been doing in the last few days.
sentences.zh: 我当时在解释我们过去几天一直在做的事情。

sentences.en: So I'd been spending the last few days of my trip in Japan learning about wolves.
sentences.zh: 所以我在日本旅行的最后几天都在了解狼。

sentences.en: And so I started telling Daisuke-san the epic saga of the Japanese wolf.
sentences.zh: 于是我开始向大辅先生讲述日本狼的史诗般传奇。

sentences.en: The basic story is there used to be wolves in these mountains everywhere, all over Japan.
sentences.zh: 基本的故事是，以前这些山里到处都是狼，整个日本到处都是。

sentences.en: I think of a wolf as an American.
sentences.zh: 我对狼的印象是美洲式的。

sentences.en: I think of like a big timber wolf or a gray wolf, like a big, snarling, mean dog.
sentences.zh: 我想象的是像大森林狼或灰狼那样，像一只龇牙咧嘴、凶恶的大狗。

sentences.en: Japanese wolves were different.
sentences.zh: 日本狼则不同。

sentences.en: They were smaller and sort of a reddish khaki color and cute, weirdly cute for a wolf.
sentences.zh: 它们更小一些，呈红卡其色，很可爱，对于狼来说出奇地可爱。

sentences.en: Before I went on this trip, I read this book called
sentences.zh: 在我去这次旅行之前，我读过一本书叫

sentences.en: The Lost Wolves of Japan by a historian named Brett Walker.
sentences.zh: 《日本迷失的狼》，作者是一位名叫布雷特·沃克的历史学家。

sentences.en: And basically, for many thousands of years, wolves roamed all over Japan.
sentences.zh: 基本上，在几千年的时间里，狼在日本各地游荡。

sentences.en: And people revered them.
sentences.zh: 人们崇敬它们。

sentences.en: They saw them as sacred guardians.
sentences.zh: 他们把它们视为神圣的守护者。

sentences.en: They protected crops.
sentences.zh: 它们保护庄稼。

sentences.en: People worshipped at wolf shrines.
sentences.zh: 人们在狼的神社里顶礼膜拜。

sentences.en: And they left offerings of rice and beans outside of wolf dens.
sentences.zh: 他们在狼穴外面留下大米和豆子作为供品。

sentences.en: But then in the 1700s, there was this big rabies outbreak that made wolves actually quite dangerous.
sentences.zh: 但到了18世纪1700年代，爆发了一场严重的狂犬病，这使得狼实际上变得相当危险。

sentences.en: Wolves were killing people.
sentences.zh: 狼在咬死人。

sentences.en: And then in the 1800s, there is a huge cultural shift in Japan where the country started to, quote unquote, modernize.
sentences.zh: 然后在19世纪1800年代，日本发生了巨大的文化转变，这个国家开始所谓的现代化。

sentences.en: People started doing Western-style agriculture, huge cattle herds.
sentences.zh: 人们开始搞西方风格的农业，拥有巨大的牛群。

sentences.en: And so wolves began to seem like pests.
sentences.zh: 因此狼开始被视为害兽。

sentences.en: They were killing livestock.
sentences.zh: 它们在捕食牲畜。

sentences.en: They were, you know, encroaching on these cities that were growing deeper into the wilderness.
sentences.zh: 它们，你知道，在侵占那些向荒野深处不断扩张的城市。

sentences.en: And so Japan decided it was done with its wolves.
sentences.zh: 于是日本决定不再容忍它的狼群。

sentences.en: And the government sends out these hunting parties to systematically exterminate the Japanese wolf.
sentences.zh: 政府派出了这些狩猎队，系统地消灭日本狼。

sentences.en: And they did.
sentences.zh: 他们确实这么做了。

sentences.en: They used guns.
sentences.zh: 他们用枪。

sentences.en: They used poison.
sentences.zh: 他们用毒药。

sentences.en: They used traps.
sentences.zh: 他们用陷阱。

sentences.en: As far as we know,
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，

sentences.en: the last Japanese wolf was killed in 1905.
sentences.zh: 最后一只日本狼于1905年被杀。

sentences.en: And it's historically documented.
sentences.zh: 这在历史上是有据可查的。

sentences.en: And they know where it was exactly.
sentences.zh: 而且他们确切知道它在哪里。

sentences.en: And they know which wolf it was.
sentences.zh: 他们知道那是哪只狼。

sentences.en: It was a male wolf.
sentences.zh: 那是一只公狼。

sentences.en: And it was brought dead and sold to a Western man in 1905.
sentences.zh: 它在1905年被带回并死后卖给了一个西方人。

sentences.en: They say the last known Japanese wolf, it was seen kind of skulking around this lumber yard in a little remote village.
sentences.zh: 据说最后一只已知的日本狼，当时被看到在某个偏远小村庄的一处木材厂附近鬼鬼祟祟地游荡。

sentences.en: And somebody shot it and sold it to a Western man who was passing through town collecting zoological specimens.
sentences.zh: 有人开枪打死了它，并把它卖给了一个路过该镇收集动物学标本的西方人。

sentences.en: And so this statue that we're going to is the memorial to that last wolf.
sentences.zh: 所以我们要去的这座雕像就是对那只最后的狼的纪念。

sentences.en: It's a black metal statue based on the body of that wolf near where that wolf died.
sentences.zh: 这是一尊黑色的金属雕像，以那只狼的身体为原型，建在那只狼死去的地方附近。

sentences.en: And so we were driving out to sea.
sentences.zh: 于是我们一路驱车前往。

sentences.en: I'm really happy that I'm able to be part of the trip because I really love dogs myself.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴自己能参与这次旅行，因为我自己非常喜欢狗。

sentences.en: And I'm able to maybe share
sentences.zh: 我也能够或许分享

sentences.en: how you might feel about this trip or going to look for the dog and look for the wolf.
sentences.zh: 你对这次旅行或去寻找这只狗和寻找这只狼的感受。

sentences.en: Daisuke was the chattiest, probably the chattiest cab driver
sentences.zh: 大辅是我遇到过的最健谈的，可能也是最健谈的出租车司机

sentences.en: I've ever had.
sentences.zh: 我从未遇到过比他更健谈的。

sentences.en: And whatever he talked about, it always came back to Gotoro.
sentences.zh: 不管他聊什么，最后总能扯到小五郎身上。

sentences.en: For instance, he was telling us like, oh, I'm a YouTuber
sentences.zh: 比如，他跟我们说，哦，我是个YouTuber

sentences.en: and I have a YouTube channel about cars.
sentences.zh: 我有一个关于汽车的YouTube频道。

sentences.en: And I said, oh, what's the name of the YouTube channel?
sentences.zh: 然后我说，哦，这个YouTube频道叫什么名字？

sentences.en: Because I immediately wanted to look it up.
sentences.zh: 因为我当时就想去搜一下。

sentences.en: And he said, something, something, I don't speak Japanese, so I can understand it.
sentences.zh: 他说，叽里呱啦说了一堆，我不会日语，所以听不懂。

sentences.en: But I distinctly heard the word Gotoro.
sentences.zh: 但我清清楚楚地听到了“小五郎”这个词。

sentences.en: I said, wait a second.
sentences.zh: 我说，等等。

sentences.en: Did he say Gotoro again?
sentences.zh: 他刚才是不是又说小五郎了？

sentences.en: Is his YouTube channel named after the Chihuahua?
sentences.zh: 他的YouTube频道是以那只吉娃娃的名字命名的吗？

sentences.en: And Samson said, yes, it's basically driving with Gotoro.
sentences.zh: 然后森森说，对，基本上就是“和小五郎一起开车”。

sentences.en: Driving channel.
sentences.zh: 汽车频道。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So, where are we?
sentences.zh: 所以，我们现在在哪？

sentences.en: We really are out in the middle of nowhere on this tiny road.
sentences.zh: 我们真的是在这条小路上前不着村后不着店的。

sentences.en: So, we are in this car for a very long time, driving on these windy roads into the mountains,

sentences.zh: 我们大老远跑来，我觉得有点犹豫，不过我想我们还是去看看它吧。

sentences.en: There was something, there's something really powerful about the scale of it being the actual scale of the body of the animal itself.
sentences.zh: 有些东西，这种按动物实际体型制作的雕塑，其规模本身就有一种真正强大的力量。

sentences.en: It's so much smaller than I thought.
sentences.zh: 它比我想象的要小得多。

sentences.en: I've seen a photo of it before, but standing in front of it, it looks like a, it looks like a pet dog.
sentences.zh: 我以前见过它的照片，但站在它面前，它看起来就像一，看起来就像一只宠物狗。

sentences.en: It looks like a pet dog.
sentences.zh: 它看起来像一只宠物狗。

sentences.en: It looks like a, like a million dogs that I've played with.
sentences.zh: 它看起来像我玩过的无数只狗中的一只。

sentences.en: Just kind of like a small medium dog.
sentences.zh: 就像一只中小型犬那样。

sentences.en: It's just like cute, but it's also fierce.
sentences.zh: 它既可爱，又透着一股凶猛。

sentences.en: It's this black metal.
sentences.zh: 这是黑色的金属。

sentences.en: It's got its mouth wide open.
sentences.zh: 它大张着嘴巴。

sentences.en: You can see its teeth.
sentences.zh: 你能看到它的牙齿。

sentences.en: I think it's howling, which reminds me they call it, hold on.
sentences.zh: 我想它在嚎叫，这让我想起他们管这叫，等等。

sentences.en: Looking at my Japanese term.
sentences.zh: 看看我的日语词汇。

sentences.en: I'd learned this word earlier on the trip.
sentences.zh: 我是在这次旅行的早期学到这个词的。

sentences.en: This incredible Japanese word, which is power spotto, which is just adoption from English power spot.
sentences.zh: 这个神奇的日语词汇，叫做 power spotto，就是从英语 power spot 借用过来的。

sentences.en: So just a place that's really full of power.
sentences.zh: 所以就是一个充满力量的地方。

sentences.en: And this, to me, standing by this statue was powerful.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，站在这个雕像旁，这种感觉很有力量。

sentences.en: Just this humble, modest little, little thing, kind of an afterthought of a memorial.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是这样一个卑微、朴素的小东西，就像是一个纪念碑的余绪。

sentences.en: One, uh, Japanese term from the book we were reading, um, it says the Japanese once revered the wolf as obuchi no magami, or large mouthed pure God.
sentences.zh: 我们读的那本书里有一个日语词汇，嗯，上面说日本人曾经尊崇狼为“大神”（obuchi no magami），也就是大口的纯洁之神。

sentences.en: And you can see the large mouth.
sentences.zh: 你能看到那个大嘴巴。

sentences.en: I mean, the jaws are wide open.
sentences.zh: 我是说，它的下巴大张着。

sentences.en: It's howling.
sentences.zh: 它在嚎叫。

sentences.en: I really would love to hear what that howl sounds like.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想听听那种嚎叫声是什么样的。

sentences.en: So, yeah, we stood and, um, Samson, who, one of the great things about Samson is he is just completely unflappable, unimpressed by anything.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我们站着，嗯，森森——森森的优点之一就是他完全处变不惊，对任何事都不为所动。

sentences.en: So how do you feel, having been on this journey with us, uh, knowing all that you know now about the wolf story,
sentences.zh: 那么，经历了这次旅程，呃，在你了解了所有关于狼的故事之后，你有什么感想？

sentences.en: coming all this ridiculous way to make this pilgrimage to stand at this statue that no one ever comes to, I think, pretty much.
sentences.zh: 大老远跑来朝圣，站在这个几乎没人会来的雕像前，我想。

sentences.en: How do you feel standing in front of it?
sentences.zh: 站在它面前你有什么感觉？

sentences.en: Was it worth it?
sentences.zh: 这值得吗？

sentences.en: Do you feel anything?
sentences.zh: 你有什么感觉吗？

sentences.en: When I first heard about the story that we were going to go after an animal that was supposed to be extinct, like, over a hundred years ago,
sentences.zh: 当我第一次听到这个故事时，我们要去寻找一种据说已经灭绝了一百多年的动物，

sentences.en: I wasn't sure what I was going to expect.
sentences.zh: 我不知道自己会期待什么。

sentences.en: Like, and then we're here now, and, and, and, and, and I, I, I, I do feel listening to you talk about how this guy here we have in front of me, particular, lost everything.
sentences.zh: 就像，然后我们现在到了这里，而且，而且，而且，我确实感觉到，听着你讲述我面前这个家伙，尤其是他失去了所有的一切。

sentences.en: And he's the last one.
sentences.zh: 他是最后一个。

sentences.en: Like, what would the last statue of a person be like?
sentences.zh: 如果是关于人的最后一尊雕像会是什么样的？

sentences.en: What would the last statue of a dog or cat be like?
sentences.zh: 如果是一只狗或猫的最后一尊雕像会是什么样的？

sentences.en: How would human think of that?
sentences.zh: 人类会怎么看待这个？

sentences.en: Especially in Japan when he is literally a god, big god.
sentences.zh: 尤其是在日本，他字面意义上就是神，大神。

sentences.en: And now he's just a stone, you know, in the middle of the street.
sentences.zh: 而现在他只是一块石头，你知道的，就在街道中央。

sentences.en: And it's even difficult to park your car because there's no road to this thing, you know.
sentences.zh: 甚至连停车都很困难，因为去这东西连路都没有，你知道的。

sentences.en: Whilst we pray on other things that we call God, that has replaced this thing.
sentences.zh: 而我们却在祈祷其他被称为神的东西，它们取代了这个东西。

sentences.en: And that's pretty deep now.
sentences.zh: 这现在听起来挺深刻的。

sentences.en: Yeah, so you're having some feelings and thoughts.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以你有一些感受和想法。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The unimpressable Samson.
sentences.zh: 淡定自若的森森。

sentences.en: It's kind of sad.
sentences.zh: 这有点悲伤。

sentences.en: What do you think about it?
sentences.zh: 你对此怎么看？

sentences.en: It is really profound.
sentences.zh: 这真的很深奥。

sentences.en: This was the last thing of its kind.
sentences.zh: 这是同类中的最后一个。

sentences.en: And the rain is coming down.
sentences.zh: 雨还在下着。

sentences.en: It's just, it's like soaking, it's like dripping off the fangs of the statue.
sentences.zh: 它就像，就像在浸透，就像水珠从雕像的尖牙上滴落。

sentences.en: And then Daisuke pulls out his phone and says,
sentences.zh: 然后大辅掏出手机说，

sentences.en: Oh, I want to show you a picture of Gotoro.
sentences.zh: 哦，我想给你们看一张五郎的照片。

sentences.en: Sure, let's see Gotoro.
sentences.zh: 当然，让我们看看五郎。

sentences.en: And as we're standing next to the statue of the last Japanese wolf, he shows us on his, on his phone screen, this picture of this little white chihuahua.
sentences.zh: 当我们站在最后一只日本狼的雕像旁时，他在手机屏幕上给我们看了一张这只小白吉娃娃的照片。

sentences.en: She's so cute.
sentences.zh: 她太可爱了。

sentences.en: We were just like, our hearts melted.
sentences.zh: 我们当时简直心都要融化了。

sentences.en: She's laying on her side in like a nest of blankets and having her belly rubbed and her eyes are closed.
sentences.zh: 她侧躺在一堆毯子里，有人在给她揉肚子，她的眼睛闭着。

sentences.en: And it just looks like the sweetest little thing.
sentences.zh: 看起来就像最可爱的小东西。

sentences.en: And like, she's so happy and in heaven.
sentences.zh: 而且，她那么快乐，就像在天堂一样。

sentences.en: One last question for Daisuke-san.
sentences.zh: 给大辅桑的最后一个问题。

sentences.en: So, the wolf is howling.
sentences.zh: 所以，狼在嚎叫。

sentences.en: I really wonder what its howl sounds like.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想知道它的嚎叫声是什么样的。

sentences.en: And I wonder if maybe while he's waiting, could he find that video he told us about of Gotoro.
sentences.zh: 我想知道他趁着等待的时候，能不能找到他跟我们提过的那个关于五郎的视频。

sentences.en: So, he went back to wait for us in the car and we stood for a while longer in the rain.
sentences.zh: 于是，他回到车里等我们，我们在雨中又站了一会儿。

sentences.en: And then eventually everyone was starving and we had to go get something to eat.
sentences.zh: 然后最后大家都饿了，我们不得不去找点东西吃。

sentences.en: And, um, we got back in the car and Daisuke said,
sentences.zh: 然后，嗯，我们回到车里，大辅说，

sentences.en: Ah, I found it.
sentences.zh: 啊，我找到了。

sentences.en: I found the video.
sentences.zh: 我找到视频了。

sentences.en: And he played us this video.
sentences.zh: 他给我们播放了这段视频。

sentences.en: Of Gotoro the Chihuahua howling her little brains out at an ambulance.
sentences.zh: 吉娃娃五郎对着救护车竭尽全力地嚎叫。

sentences.en: And it's like the most, like, tender.
sentences.zh: 这简直是最，最温柔的。

sentences.en: She's howling so hard.
sentences.zh: 她叫得那么大声。

sentences.en: And it's such a soft little, such a soft little tender Chihuahua howl.
sentences.zh: 那是一种多么轻柔、多么轻柔温柔的吉娃娃嚎叫声。

sentences.en: It's so primal.
sentences.zh: 它是那么原始。

sentences.en: Imagine it coming out past the fangs of this, of this Japanese wolf.
sentences.zh: 想象一下它从这只日本狼的尖牙后面发出的声音。

sentences.en: Echoing across the wilderness.
sentences.zh: 在荒野中回荡。

sentences.en: Gotoro.
sentences.zh: 五郎。

sentences.zh: 非常感谢你们教导我们关于日本狼以及它与狗、人类、哭泣等等的一切联系。

sentences.zh: 谢谢收听。

sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter 秀》中，我们要为假期接待客人做好准备。

sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让您的客人在宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是沾床就睡的那种人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会晕倒睡觉的那种。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症、食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.zh: 在纽约时报应用上或您喜欢收听播客的地方寻找《Wirecutter 秀》。
